card.title: SHTURMOVIK Il-2M
card.text: When this unit attacks and destroys a unit, deal excess damage to the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The Shturmovik, or Ilyushin Il-2, was a Soviet ground-attack aircraft used during WWII. It was one of the most produced military aircraft in history, with a total of 36,183 units being built, and it played a crucial role on the Eastern Front. The pilots called it "Ilyusha", but soldiers referred to it as the "Hunchback", the "Flying Tank" and the "Flying Infantryman".
